comment: One thing here is NOT probe-able: CollapsedReadSearchContent reads teamMemoryReadCount through the feature('TEAMMEM') module, and feature() is false under the runner — so replacing that argument with 0 turns nothing red. Verified instead by hand-folding all four TEAMMEM gates in that file to `true` and rendering (2026-09-21): readCount 3 + memoryReadCount 1 + teamMemoryReadCount 2 gave 'Read 3 files (ctrl+o to expand)' on the badge and '⎿  Loaded 1 memory, 2 team memories' below it. The wording either side of that link is covered by memoryRecallLine.test.ts and teamMemCollapsed.test.tsx.

probes.name: the team count is labelled team, not folded into the private wording
nothing recalled returns undefined, so no empty Loaded line renders
the collapsed group renders the Loaded line at all
a recall-only group drops the empty badge row instead of printing it
probes.find: const hasBadgeParts = nonMemParts.length > 0 || memParts.length > 0 || teamMemParts !== null;

probes.name: getTeamMemoryReadCount reads the group's own count
the standalone attachment says Loaded, matching the collapsed group
an empty memory list renders no line
